variables.description: The host port for accessing the Technitium DNS Server web console via HTTP.
variables.label: DNS Web Console Port

variables.description: The host port for the standard DNS service over UDP. Typically port 53.
variables.label: DNS UDP Port

variables.description: The host port for the standard DNS service over TCP. Typically port 53.
variables.label: DNS TCP Port

variables.description: The host port for the DNS-over-TLS (DoT) service. Typically port 853.
variables.label: DNS-over-TLS Port

variables.description: The host port for the DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) service. Typically port 443.
variables.label: DNS-over-HTTPS Port

variables.description: The host port for the DNS-over-QUIC (DoQ) service. Typically port 853.
variables.label: DNS-over-QUIC Port

variables.description: The primary fully qualified domain name used by this DNS Server to identify itself.
variables.label: DNS Server Domain

variables.description: The password for the DNS web console admin user. This is set on first run.
variables.label: DNS Web Console Admin Password

variables.description: Set to 'true' to enable blocking of domain names using Blocked Zone and Block List Zone features.
variables.label: Enable Ad/Malware Blocking

variables.description: A comma-separated list of URLs for block lists (e.g., hosts files) to be used for ad and malware blocking.
variables.label: Block List URLs

variables.description: A comma-separated list of IP addresses for upstream DNS forwarders (e.g., Cloudflare, Google DNS).
variables.label: Upstream DNS Forwarders

variables.description: The protocol to use for upstream DNS forwarders. Options: Udp, Tcp, Tls, Https, HttpsJson.
variables.label: Forwarder Protocol

variables.description: Defines who can use the DNS server for recursive queries. Options: Allow, Deny, AllowOnlyForPrivateNetworks, UseSpecifiedNetworkACL.
variables.label: Recursion Mode

variables.description: Comma-separated list of IP addresses or network addresses (CIDR) to allow/deny recursion. Only valid for 'UseSpecifiedNetworkACL' recursion mode. Prefix with '!' to deny.
variables.label: Recursion Network ACL

variables.description: Maximum number of days to keep log files. Log files older than this will be deleted automatically. Set to 0 to disable auto-delete.
variables.label: Max Log File Days

variables.description: Set to 'true' to make the DNS Server prefer IPv6 for querying whenever possible.
variables.label: Prefer IPv6 for Queries
